published.source: the DPS report's main run of this request after the November 11 hotfixes (Judgement as a ranged attack, Unsealed Wrath without Windfury Totem copies, no extra attack rolling Windfury Totem) and the re-tuned seal rotation (wowsimcli, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s)

summary: Holy Shock with most points in Retribution, Seal of Righteousness up with no twisting.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Consecration on cooldown at any mana
Seal of Righteousness whenever it's down (no twisting)
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Holy Strike
Holy Shock on cooldown, ahead of Holy Strike
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Holy Shock needs 20 points in Holy, so Unsealed Wrath (the 31-point Retribution talent) is out of reach.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: mksettings -spec ret -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_shock_ret -talents 550030032011012--052150312012303 -race Undead; primarySeal set to Command to match the shipped preset's options. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh).
